name: profile-2
title: Compact Profile Card
description: Compact centered profile card with avatar, role, location, a three column stat strip, and Follow and Message buttons for sidebars or directories.

standards.purpose: Present one person or organization with the facts needed to recognize and act on them.
useWhen: The page is about a single account, member, or company.
doNotUseWhen: Several entities of the same kind are being compared (use a list or table).

rules.check: Names, roles, and stats are real or clearly labeled sample data.
Avatar and cover images carry alt text, or empty alt when decorative.
Follow or message actions reflect the viewer's permissions and never appear on their own profile.
